title: Emma
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Victorian London, William Jones, son of a wealthy merchant family, visits his former governess and falls for her quiet, beautiful maid Emma (Yen Press blurb via AniList and MU). Society's strict class codes and his father's plan to marry him into the peerage stand in the way of a romance between a gentleman and a working-class girl; volumes 8 to 10 are side stories (MU).
life_message: Genuine love, honest work and kindness are worth more than social rank, though crossing class lines carries real costs.

content.note: Social pressure and heartbreak rather than danger (MU Star-Crossed Lovers).
Romance is central; Nudity tag at mid rank (AniList 42), not described elsewhere (to verify).

dominant: Love across class lines; quiet virtue of work; social hierarchy questioned

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: The romance breaks class lines; MU Breaking Societal Norms.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Victorian tradition honored in detail yet questioned.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Personal love chosen over family advancement (MU Forbidden Love).

folkways.japan: Kaoru Mori's careful research reflects a Japanese fascination with British maids and manners; restraint and diligence also match Japanese ideals.

delivery.evidence: Quiet slice-of-life romance per blurbs and tags (to verify).
delivery.note: Class codes are shown as real constraints with reasons, not only as villainy (to verify).

winners_losers: Love across class lines is the story's hope; rigid class ambition is the obstacle. Sympathy is with Emma and personal worth.
